metadata.title: Monochromatic Portrait with Red Script Title

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, high-contrast studio portrait featuring a person in urban attire leaning against a luxury black car, with a skateboard propped beside the car. The composition is anchored by the figure and vehicle, with a vibrant red script title placed in the upper left quadrant, providing the sole color accent.
coreVisualRelationships: The red script title contrasts sharply with the monochromatic background and subject.
The figure and car form a strong, dark mass against the lighter background.
The skateboard acts as a secondary vertical element, reinforcing the urban theme.
The high contrast between light and shadow emphasizes textures and forms.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic image with a single, vibrant color accent for the title.
Studio lighting creating strong shadows and highlights.
Figure positioned to the left of a luxury car.
Skateboard placed vertically next to the car.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject (person) is positioned slightly to the left of the vertical center, occupying approximately 40% of the image height. The luxury car fills the right two-thirds of the frame, providing a substantial backdrop. The title is in the upper left, scaled to be prominent but not overwhelming.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure leaning against the car serves as the primary visual anchor due to its central placement and human element.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the figure, then follows the line of the car to the right, and finally moves upwards to the red script title. The skateboard provides a vertical stop to the rightward movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and lower left corners contain significant negative space, allowing the main subjects to stand out. The background is a smooth, gradient studio wall, contributing to the clean negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The dominant 'color' is the grayscale spectrum, providing a classic and sophisticated base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The deep blacks of the car and clothing, contrasted with the bright whites of the floor and highlights, create strong visual tension.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red is used exclusively for the title, drawing immediate attention and providing a focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The image is entirely desaturated except for the title. The grayscale elements exhibit a wide range of values, from deep shadows to bright highlights, creating high contrast. The red title is highly saturated.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic for the main image content.
One single, vibrant accent color for text elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A flowing, elegant script with high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Uppercase letters have prominent, decorative swashes and loops.
Lowercase letters connect smoothly with generous spacing.
Ascenders and descenders are elongated and graceful.
Stroke endings are tapered and refined.

composition.relationshipToImage: floats above the monochromatic image as a distinct, colored element

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The script font is used as a singular, elegant statement, contrasting with the gritty, realistic photographic style. No other typographic elements are present to pair with it.
graphicDevices: The parental advisory explicit content label is a standard, small graphic element in the bottom right corner.

preserve: high contrast between thick and thin strokes
avoid: handwritten styles that are too informal or messy

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: formal script font (e.g., Bickham Script Pro, Edwardian Script ITC)
candidateDirections.reason: These fonts offer the desired elegance, high stroke contrast, and flowing connections.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: calligraphic script font (e.g., Snell Roundhand, Zapf Chancery)
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten feel with varying stroke widths.
Many contemporary script fonts offer similar stylistic elements and legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic studio portrait of a person in urban attire leaning against a luxury black car, with a skateboard propped beside the car. Ensure strong lighting creates dramatic shadows and highlights. The background should be a plain, light gray studio wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the generated image with a prominent, elegant script title in vibrant red in the upper left quadrant. Ensure the text is smooth, clean, and without any texture or distortion. Add a standard 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main image content entirely monochromatic?
Is the title the only element with color, specifically vibrant red?
Does the title use an elegant, high-contrast script font?
Is the 'Parental Advisory' label present and correctly positioned?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the title
Exact script font used for the title
Lighting intensity and direction for the monochromatic image
Angle and specific model of the luxury car

mustAchieve: A sophisticated and high-contrast monochromatic aesthetic for the main image.
A clear, legible, and elegant red script title that stands out.
A sense of luxury and urban style conveyed by the subject and props.
avoid: Low contrast or muddy grayscale tones.
Inconsistent color application (e.g., other colored elements besides the title).
Poorly lit or composed subject matter.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the main image is strictly black and white/grayscale.
Confirm that the title is the only element in color and that it is red.
Check for the elegance and legibility of the script font.
Ensure the overall composition is balanced and visually impactful.
Confirm the presence and correct placement of the 'Parental Advisory' label.
Assess the contrast and lighting quality of the monochromatic photograph.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic studio portrait + luxury car + urban figure + skateboard + vibrant red elegant script title in upper left + parental advisory label in bottom right.
